🌡️ Section 2: All Temperature Transmitters (Direct InfluxDB Flux Query)

targets.query:
from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "process_telemetry" and r.tag_name =~ /^TT/ and r._field == "value_scaled")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "mean")

panels.title: All 15 Temperature Transmitters (InfluxDB Stream)
🌊 Section 3: Flow Rates Monitoring: FT04 (Product), FT10 (Hotwater), and (FT10 - FT04)

targets.query:
ft04 = from(bucket: "telemetry") |> range(start: -1h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "process_telemetry" and r.tag_name == "FT04" and r._field == "value_scaled") |> last()
ft10 = from(bucket: "telemetry") |> range(start: -1h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "process_telemetry" and r.tag_name == "FT10" and r._field == "value_scaled") |> last()
diff = join(tables: {a: ft04, b: ft10}, on: ["_field"]) |> map(fn: (r) => ({_start: r._start_a, _stop: r._stop_a, _time: r._time_a, _measurement: "process_telemetry", _field: "value_scaled", tag_name: "ΔF (FT10 - FT04)", _value: r._value_b - r._value_a}))
union(tables: [ft04, ft10, diff])

⚙️ Section 11: Pump Inverters & Motor Drives Configuration (MySQL Config Master)

targets.rawSql: SELECT i.tag_name AS 'Signal Tag', ig.group_code AS 'Pump Equipment', i.db_number AS 'DB #', CONCAT('Byte ', i.byte_offset, IF(i.plc_data_format='BOOL', CONCAT('.', i.bit_offset), '')) AS 'Siemens Offset', i.plc_data_format AS 'PLC Format', i.engineering_unit AS 'Unit', i.description AS 'Telemetry Description' FROM process_instruments i JOIN instrument_groups ig ON i.group_id = ig.id WHERE i.tag_name LIKE 'SX%' ORDER BY i.id;

panels.title: Pump Inverters & Motor Drives Configuration (vw_siemens_plc_db_map)
📋 Section 12: All 65 SCADA Instruments Catalog & Alarm Interlocks (MySQL Master)

targets.rawSql: SELECT tag_name AS 'Tag Label', db_number AS 'DB #', byte_offset AS 'Byte Offset', bit_offset AS 'Bit Offset', plc_data_format AS 'S7 Type', scale_eng_min AS 'Min', scale_eng_max AS 'Max', engineering_unit AS 'Unit', description AS 'Description' FROM vw_siemens_plc_db_map ORDER BY db_number, byte_offset, bit_offset;

panels.title: All 65 SCADA Instruments Catalog (MySQL Master)

targets.rawSql: SELECT tag_name AS 'Tag Name', alarm_type AS 'Alarm Mode', threshold_value AS 'Setpoint / Trigger', engineering_unit AS 'UOM', IF(is_enabled=1, 'ACTIVE', 'DISABLED') AS 'Status' FROM vw_instrument_alarms;
